title: HRD-related morphology discovery in breast cancer by controlling for confounding factors.
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习从乳腺癌H&E切片预测同源重组缺陷，聚焦组织形态学而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Lazard et al.(1) predict homologous recombination deficiency from hematoxylin and eosin-stained slides of breast cancer tissue using deep learning. By controlling for technical artifacts on a curated dataset, the model puts forward novel HRD-related morphologies in luminal breast cancers.
abstract_zh: Lazard等人(1)利用深度学习从乳腺癌组织的苏木精-伊红染色切片中预测同源重组缺陷。通过在精选数据集上控制技术伪影，该模型提出了管腔型乳腺癌中与HRD相关的新型形态学特征。
